mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are decreasing, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS are decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals growing economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is decreasing and real GDP (GDPC1) is increasing, it signals a supply-demand mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is decreasing and GDPC1 is increasing.
